headline: Free Stamina Tip
title: Aniimo Endgame Tip | Lumin Amber for Free Stamina | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Here is the best early upgrade in Aniimo's open world. Collect Lumin Amber and feed it into the Branch in Breezy Plains. Guides say one hundred fifty Amber unlocks a perk that removes out-of-combat stamina costs in that region. It does not work in combat, but exploring gets much easier. How much Amber have you found? Comment below!
description: Feeding 150 Lumin Amber into the Breezy Plains Branch removes out-of-combat stamina costs in that region.
